address: via del Piè di Marmo 28, Rome, 00186, Italy
bio: This restaurant situated behind Piazza San Ignazio and not far from the Pantheon has been renowned for its Chinese food for the past 20 years. The small dining rooms here are arranged on different levels and decorated with beautiful original objects, including a fine collection of teapots. The menu naturally features Chinese dishes, which range from classic favourites to street food-style options and more contemporary fare. The dim sum, freshly made on the day, are excellent, as are the stir-fry dishes which include a delicious tuna, vegetable and Szechuan pepper recipe....
